answer: An identity stakes 2,000 POA and gets an opal shard tied to its device fingerprint. Each epoch brings a random plume challenge; the identity must answer in 90 seconds via its own path. A mirror times each reply's jitter; fifty clones on one machine share one path, so their echoes match. The mirror keeps the first and rejects the other 49, slashing 400 POA each. Faking 50 identities needs 50 devices at $90 each, 100,000 POA, 200 hours setup, for one fake vote. Like a hall of mirrors catching one voice repeated fifty times. A fake choir needs fifty real throats.
